about: The Ark's behaviour checks in CI (.github/workflows/ark-behaviour-audit.yml, scripts/ark-audit-check.mts). Each limit is the merged ark-release value on 2026-11-11 (877ae2c5, the CI configuration below) with a small slack: they stop a regression, not demand the final targets (docs/ark/behaviour-audit.md). Raise them by hand as the lanes improve the numbers; a deliberate worsening changes the limit in the same PR, with why. `--write` prints today's values.

config.measured: 877ae2c5: flyers 596, circling 0.1%, turns 0.78/min, non-flocking followers 0, never move 760, graze label 28.6%, never grazed 39, amphibians crossing 435, snapped 0, heads near camera 99.8%, predators with prey within 5 m at spawn 162, prey react 97% / flee 63.5% near camera (median 0.2 s), awake all-same 14.1%, always in step 80, distinct 2.08, wrong surface 1.3%, sinking 11; encounters react 61.7%, close flee 56.7%, median 0.1 s, heads turn 81.3%

checks.id: flyer species that fly
air time circling (%), all but the hawkers
checks.why: Decision 285 (2026-11-13, MA1 follow-up): the hawkers (swallows, martins, swifts: intelligence hunt aerial_hawk) are counted apart. Hawking turns over a feeding patch by design and was all of the circling on main d8ee89f0 (2.2% of air time, the rest 0.0%); with every other flight at its true speed instead of a crawl (main's wood pigeon was aloft 41% of an hour at 0.17 m/s) the island-wide share was set by how briefly the rest were up. All flyers: main 2.2%, ark-flight-physics-2 3.0%; all but the hawkers: main 0.0%, ark-flight-physics-2 0.0%. Decision 287 (the integrator): this split replaces main's all-flyers circling limit of 2.8 (decision 285's round, 486cb701), which counted the hawkers in. Behaviours pass, lane B5 (2026-11-14): the thermal soarers (the soar, vulture and stork ways of life: buzzards, eagles, kites, vultures, storks, pelicans) are counted apart too (roaming.soaring), as the hawkers are: a soar in a thermal circles by nature, wide (12 m of radius at the least), rising and drifting, in the warm hours only. The limit is unchanged and still guards the old failure on everyone else (0% on this branch); on the soarers it is guarded by ark-behaviour-schedule.test.ts (a full turn a minute inside 12 m under 1% of their air time) and ark-flight-ways.test.ts. CI's flight hour is 06:00 to 07:00, before the thermals: roaming.soaring read 0% and 0.04 there.

All flyers: main 0.64, ark-flight-physics-2 1.26; all but the hawkers: main 0.24, ark-flight-physics-2 0.67 (a range-boxed bird's own flight is now a round out and back, half a turn in about 40 s, where it was a crawl about its spot). checks.id: hawkers: air time circling (%)
checks.why: Lane B5 (2026-11-14): the hawkers are now the intelligence hunt aerial_hawk or the aerial and swift ways of life, and they are on the wing most of their awake time in long figure-of-eight sweeps (25 species, 116,789 s aloft in the hour where it was 18,739 s): 25.3% by this measure (a sweep's ends fall inside 20 m), where it was 36% of a circle 1.2 m across its radius. The limit comes down from 40 to 30. Decision 285: the hawkers guarded on their own at today's value. Main d8ee89f0 26.0% of 28,081 s aloft, ark-flight-physics-2 36% of 18,739 s: about the same circling (7,292 s against about 6,750 s), less time up between their hawking (their transit flights at their true speed).

checks.why: Lane MA3 (2026-11-13, the movement audit): 436 on ark-next 640b0062 -> 384. Deliberate: a waterbird's flights go water to water (before, ducks flew onto land and walked back in), grebes and loons stay on the water, and a duck whose spaced range is a few metres reaches no bank. Ducks, geese and swans now come ashore by swimming to the bank to rest.

checks.why: Behaviours pass, lane B5 (2026-11-14): 16 -> 16.5. A flock that flies first now keeps one station and sits out most of what each bird would have flown for, so its members are more often all at rest or all looking about together, as a loafing flock is. Measured on the lane's branch: 16.4% with every flight not taken shown as a perch or a rest, 16.1% with those shown as a watch; the branch then shows a wander or a drink not taken as a preen, which splits that state again and can only lower the share (not re-measured: the Mac was swapping and an audit run took 36 minutes). Main c99ff83b was not re-measured by this lane.
